Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Cutting edge cyber-armor that resists cracks at the molecular level.

External Body Cyberware. Requires 3 Option Slots. The user’s body and head are armored at SP 12. All incoming ablation this armor would suffer is reduced by 1 (Minimum 0). Compatible with all Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements except Guard. Incompatible with all other forms of Skinweave, Subdermal Armor, and Dragoon Plating. Nano-Plating repairs itself for 1 point of lost SP at the end of each day in which it does not lose SP.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 3

Foundry notes:

  • Cyberware items carry no SP, so the SP 12 comes as a separate armor item, "Nano-Plating (Armor)", the way the core system splits Subdermal Armor into a cyberware piece and an armor piece. Equip both.
  • The reduced ablation and the daily self-repair are applied by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
